svg.text: Every stage gets a permanent ID linked to the stage before it — so any rice bag traces back to its truck.
✓ Permanent ID — RST resets, this never does

• Dryer it goes into, start / end, operator
✓ Any finished tanks · any free dryer

Dried paddy waits for the mill

• Start / end of each of 6 machines

Trace in both directions: OUT → MIL → MFD → DRY → LOT → SOAK → RCV (truck, RST, vehicle, supplier)
and from any truck forward to every rice grade it produced — with every time, quantity and person on record.
